truth_boundary: This guard proves selected repository evidence declarations agree at one commit, including the machine matrix, primary root-gate report, public README count, and bounded successor-possession plus exact rotation-revocation truth boundaries in TRUST_MODEL.md. The new rotation-revocation checkpoint-lineage boundary is recorded separately in its falsifier-first experiment, executable result strings, machine-readable evidence, and primary root-gate report rather than being silently generalized into the existing Trust Model sections. This guard does not prove fixture completeness, documentation completeness, semantic correctness beyond exercised cases, external independence, hostile-environment security, or AXM-wide CANON status.
